info.description: The Banking Accounts Limits API provides developers the ability to retrieve information about the limits associated with customer banking accounts. This endpoint is essential for financial institutions and service providers looking to manage account constraints effectively. Typical use cases include displaying account limits to customers or assessing eligibility for specific banking features. By leveraging this API, applications can enhance user experience through transparent limit management, ensuring compliance and informed decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the limits associated with a specific account. It provides essential information that helps you understand the restrictions and allowances related to your account usage.

requestBody.description: This request body should include the necessary parameters to retrieve the limits associated with the specified accounts. Ensure that all required fields are populated accurately to get the desired data.
